spans.s: कु-मंत्र m. 1. bad advice; 2. a charm employed to secure success in a bad cause.
कुमार् vi. 10U (pp. कुमारित) to play, to sport.

कुमार m. 1. A son, a boy, a youth, R.iii.48; 2. a boy below five; 3. a prince, an heir-apparent (especially in theatrical language), विप्रोषितकुमारं तद्राज्यमस्तमितेश्वरम् R.xii.11; 4. a name of Skanda, the god of war, कुमारोऽपि कुमारविक्रमः R.iii.55; 5. a parrot; 6. the river Sindhu.
कुमार-पालन m. 1. one who takes care of children; 2. a name of king Śālivāhana.
कुमार-भृत्या f. 1. care of a young child; 2. care of a woman in pregnancy or confinement, midwifery, R.iii.12.
कुमार-वाहिन्, -वाहन m. a peacock.
कुमार-वाहिन्, -वाहन m. a peacock.
कुमार-सू f. 1. An epithet of Pārvatī; 2. of the Ganges.
कुमारक m. 1. A child, a youth; 2. the pupil of the eye.
कुमारिक a. (f. की) Furnished with girls, abounding in girls.
कुमारिका f. 1. A young girl, one from 10 to 12 years old; 2. a maiden, a virgin, व्यावर्ततान्योपगमात् कुमारी R.vi.69; 3. a daughter; 4. an epithet of Durgā.
कुमारिक a. (f. की) Furnished with girls, abounding in girls.

कुमारिका-पुत्र m. the son of an unmarried woman.
कुमारिका-पुत्र m. the son of an unmarried woman.
कुमारिका-श्वशुर m. the father-in-law of a girl defiled before marriage.

कुमुद् (I) a. 1. Unkind, unfriendly; 2. avaricious.
कुमुद् (II) n. 1. The white water-lily; 2. the red lotus.
कुमुद्-वत् a. abounding in lotuses, कुमुद्वत्सु च वारिषु R.iv.19.

कुमुद्-वती f. 1. an assemblage of lotuses; 2. a pond filled with lotuses; 3. a water-lily with white flowers which open at moon-rise, कुमुद्वती भानुमतीव भावम् R.vi.36, अंतर्हिते शशिनि सैव कुमुद्वती मे दृष्टिं न नंदयति संस्मरणीयशोभा Sak.iv.
कुमुद्-वती˚ईश m. the moon.
कुमुद (I) m.n. 1. The white water-lily which opens at moon-rise, कुमुदैः सरांसि Rt.iii.2, 21, 22, 23, 26, Megh.i.40; 2. red lotus.
कुमुद (II) n. Silver.
कुमुद (III) m. 1. An epithet of Viṣṇu; 2. name of the elephant that guards the south; 3. camphor; 4. a species of monkey; 5. name of a Nāga, R.xvi.76, 81, 86.
कुमुद-अभिख्य n. silver.
कुमुद-आकर, -आवास m. a pond full of lotuses.
कुमुद-आकर, -आवास m. a pond full of lotuses.
कुमुद-ईश m. the moon.
कुमुद-खंड n. an assemblage of lotuses.

कुमुद-वती f. the lotus plant with white flowers.
कुमुदिनी f. 1. An assemblage of lotuses; 2. a place abounding in them; 3. the water-lily with white flowers, उदशिश्वसत् कुमुदिनीवनिताम् Sis.ix.34.
कुमुदिनी-नायक, -पति m. the moon.
